Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

invitation — a request to come to an event. Example: I send an invitation to ten friends.
accept — to say yes to an invitation. Example: Six friends accept.
decline — to say no politely. Example: Two friends decline.
bring — to take something with you. Example: What can I bring?
food — what people eat. Example: I bring some food.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I'd love to come.
• Sorry, I can't come.
• What can I bring?
• I'll bring some food.
• See you on Saturday!
